title: VehicleState
description: Kinematic 2-D vehicle state in a flat world frame, as produced by 01_basic_simulation/vehicle/vehicle_state.py.

x.description: Longitudinal position in the world frame [m].

y.description: Lateral position in the world frame [m].

yaw.description: Heading angle [rad], counter-clockwise positive, 0 rad aligned with the +x axis.

steering_angle.description: Front wheel steering angle [rad], positive = left turn.
